mapper.insert: insert into erp_user(user_id, password, username, user_role_no, center_no, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{password}, #{username}, #{userRole.userRoleNo}, #{centerCode.centerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_code as userCode, u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.role_key as roleKey, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, r.region_name as regionName FROM ERP_USER u JOIN ERP_CENTER c ON u.center_code = c.center_code JOIN ERP_REGION_CODE r ON c.region_key = r.region_key WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.user_code as userCode, u.user_id as userId, u.password_hash as passwordHash, u.center_code as centerCode FROM ERP_USER u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
